connect.title: Connect {name}
connect.description: A read-only key: Ledgerly reads balances, positions and history, and checks the key's permissions on every sync.

etoro.1: On eToro, open Settings and its API keys page.
etoro.2: Create a key for the Real environment with the Read permission only: leave Write off.
etoro.3: Copy the public API key and the user key: eToro shows the user key once.
etoro.4: Paste both here. Ledgerly checks that every permission of the key only reads before it saves anything.

ccxt_binance.1: On Binance, open Account › API Management and create a system-generated key.
ccxt_binance.2: Leave only “Enable Reading” on: trading, withdrawals, transfers, margin, futures and options stay off.
ccxt_binance.3: Copy the API key and the secret key: Binance shows the secret once.
ccxt_binance.4: Paste both here. Ledgerly reads the key's permissions from Binance and refuses it if any of them can do more than read.

connect.readOnlyNote: A key with any permission that is not read is refused, now and on every later sync.

connect.ipUnrestrictedTitle: {name} connected: the key is not restricted by IP
connect.ipUnrestricted: The key works from any IP address: if it leaks, anyone can read the account with it. On {name}, restrict the key to the homelab's public IP, then press Verify key on the service page.
connect.currencyHint: The currency {name} reports the account in.

warnings.title: Needs your attention
warnings.unknown_code: Code {code} is not in your code map: its line is kept, but counted for nothing until you map it (Settings › Data).
warnings.tfr_both_differ: The TFR box ({monthField}) and line 8003 ({contributionLine}) differ: line 8003 is used, never both.
warnings.tfr_partial_month: TFR on a partial month: transcribed as printed, not recomputed.
warnings.employer_fund_adjustment_only: An employer fund adjustment with no regular quota beside it: no monthly employer amount is computed. Check it against the payslip before.
warnings.permit_unclassified: {hours} h of permits the ROL balance does not confirm: kept as permits, not ROL.
warnings.extra_month_leave: Leave lines on a 13th or 14th: they are not counted.
warnings.rectification: A payslip for the same month is already applied: applying this one replaces it.
warnings.missing_identity: The month, the employer or the employee was not found: correct them to go on.
warnings.unknown_layout: This is not a Reply/TeamSystem payslip: nothing could be read from it.

actions.verifyAnywayDescription: You are vouching for values that do not reconcile. They stay marked, and the register shows the payslip as it is.
actions.deleteDescription: The original and everything read from it are deleted. Nothing was applied from it.
actions.renameDescription: The name the register and this page show. The original file is not touched.
actions.name: Name
actions.reopenDescription: It leaves the register until you apply it again, with its leave and its pension contributions. If it replaced an earlier version, that version is applied again meanwhile.
actions.deleteAppliedDescription: It is applied: it leaves the register with its leave and its pension contributions, and if it replaced an earlier version that version is applied again. Then the original and everything read from it are deleted.

viewer.failed: The document could not be shown.
